title: Component
description: A unit of first-party code (a package, module, or library) and the actors it runs in. Components carry the code footprint; actors carry runtime identity.

summary.description: What it does for the system, in a sentence or two.

actors.description: The actors whose processes this code runs in, e.g. both the CLI and the server for a shared library.

dependsOn.description: Components this one calls or imports.
